messages.text:
Hello! 
 

 I was excited to receive my seeds today, but... 
 

 I ordered 3 Swamp milkweed (considered a Florida nativee), 1 Extalta, and 1 Augustifolia. 
 

 I received 5 Swamp milkweed. 
 

 How do we fix this? I was looking forward to trying the different varieties. 
 

 I live in Florida, and for years, I have grown Tropical Milkweed for the community as the caterpillar season gets busy. FL recently put Tropical Milkweed on the Invasive Plant list, so as a good steward, I now need to grow other varieties! 
 

 I appreciate your attention to this matter. 
 

 Jackie Gammon

messages.subject: Re: order #rGWDNXbvmSHPUnu1lChOtvRHq
messages.text:
Hi Jackie,

Thank you for your patience on this, and I'm sorry it took us far too long to get back to you. That's not how we like to do things, and we'll do better.

Here's the issue: the Exaltata and Angustifolia you ordered are currently out of stock in our regular seed line. Good news is our cold-stratified, ready-to-sow packets are available in Exaltata, and those save you the winter chilling step entirely. For the Angustifolia (narrow-leaf), I can either swap in another variety of your choice or refund that packet, whichever you prefer.

Since you're in Florida moving away from Tropical Milkweed, a few natives worth trying: Incarnata (Swamp, which you already have), Tuberosa, and Verticillata all do well in your climate.

Either way, please keep the extra Swamp milkweed. Just let me know which route you'd like for the Angustifolia, and confirm your shipping address is still the same as on your original order, and I'll get the replacements out to you right away.

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com

Petit mot en toute transparence : ce message a été préparé par un nouveau système de réponse assisté par intelligence artificielle, présentement en rodage. S'il y a le moindre problème, il est possible de me joindre directement au 581-982-5857 pour régler le dossier rapidement.
